description: Closed catalog of canonical fundamentals metrics for phase 5 (block C.5). Each metric records whether it is typically REPORTED directly by a provider or only ever CALCULATED downstream (block G), and which of our two approved sources (jquants_fins_summary, twse_mops_opendata) is known to report it, based on the real fields confirmed in v2.34B -- not assumed.

metrics.notes: J-Quants 'Sales'; TWSE MOPS t187ap06 '營業收入'.
TWSE MOPS t187ap06 '營業成本'. Not a distinct field in J-Quants fins/summary.
TWSE MOPS t187ap06 '營業毛利'. Not reported by J-Quants fins/summary; may be calculated there only if cost_of_sales becomes available from another source.
J-Quants 'OP'; TWSE MOPS '營業利益'.
J-Quants 'OdP' -- a JGAAP-specific concept (blank for IFRS/USGAAP filers per the provider's own documentation). No TWSE equivalent; do not force one.
TWSE MOPS '稅前淨利'. J-Quants fins/summary does not expose a distinct pretax line separate from OdP/NP.
J-Quants 'NP'; TWSE MOPS net income line.
J-Quants 'EPS'. Not confirmed in the TWSE MOPS files evaluated in v2.34B.
J-Quants 'DEPS'.
J-Quants 'CashEq'. Not confirmed in the TWSE balance-sheet file evaluated.
Not confirmed available on either approved free source; JPX detail lives behind the paid /fins/details endpoint, which this project does not use.

current_debt + noncurrent_debt; calculation_impossible_missing_components on both sources today.
gross_debt - cash_and_equivalents; blocked while gross_debt is unavailable.
TWSE MOPS t187ap07 '流動資產'. Not a distinct field in J-Quants fins/summary (only total assets).

TWSE MOPS '負債總計'. Not a distinct field in J-Quants fins/summary; would need total_assets - total_equity there, marked calculated for that source.

J-Quants 'BPS'.

Not a distinct field in J-Quants fins/summary (only aggregated CFI) or in the TWSE files evaluated.
operating_cash_flow - capex; blocked while capex is unavailable on both sources.
J-Quants per-period dividend fields ('Div1Q'..'DivAnn').
Not confirmed available on either source.
J-Quants 'ROE' -- reported by the provider itself, not our own G-block calculation; keep value_status distinguishing reported vs calculated.
J-Quants 'EqAR'.
block G: gross_profit / revenue. Only computable for TWSE (gross_profit is a reported field there); calculation_impossible_missing_components for JPX (no gross_profit/cost_of_sales in fins/summary).
block G: operating_income / revenue. Computable for both JPX and TWSE.
block G: net_income / revenue. Computable for both JPX and TWSE.
block G: net_income / total_assets. Computable for both JPX and TWSE.
block G: current_assets / current_liabilities. Only computable for TWSE (JPX fins/summary only reports total_assets, no current/non-current split).

block G: (revenue_t - revenue_t-1y) / abs(revenue_t-1y), same CurPerType one fiscal year apart, same consolidation_scope. JPX only -- TWSE's single snapshot period has no prior period to compare against.
block G: same method as revenue_growth_yoy, applied to net_income. JPX only.
